source.use: Economic motivation: own-return persistence; no published performance imported; not an exact rule replication

mechanism: Gradual adjustment and persistent investor demand can make the sign of BTC own weekly return predict the following week. This is slow own-asset persistence, not cross-asset diffusion, relative-strength ranking, volatility breakout, liquidation reversal, or calendar-day drift.

data.checksums: SHA256 with exact basename; retain original zip and checksum bytes
data.missing: Any missing date, malformed/duplicate/nonfinite/nonpositive price or bad checksum fails whole acquisition; no fill or interval substitution
data.vintage: Presently served historical archive; historical publication/revisions and executable bid/ask not authenticated; no PIT-vintage or actual-fill claim

rule.decision: Sunday 00:00 UTC opening price, with a full 24-hour latency to entry
rule.position: 1x long spot if signal positive, otherwise cash at zero yield

chronology.unopened: All 2025+ market data, all existing protected project datasets/OOS/forward
chronology.boundary_rule: Every holding interval must end within its declared partition; crossing weeks excluded by calendar only before outcomes.

costs.historical_cost_validation: Scenario model, not authenticated historical spreads/capacity; fee discounts/promotions ignored; deeper validation required

controls.always_long: long every scheduled week at same round-trip costs
controls.fixed_beta: weight=training candidate active weeks/training scheduled weeks, fixed in validation; each week weight times always-long weekly net
controls.reversal: long if lagged weekly return <=0 on the same Monday windows
controls.one_week_delayed: same sign rule evaluated exactly seven days earlier, same Monday entry/exit
controls.random_timing: long iff int(SHA256(fingerprint|entry_date|random)[:16],16) modulo 2 == 0; fixed outcome-blind schedule

metrics: active nonoverlapping weeks, not asserted IID
weekly-marked compounded NAV and maximum drawdown; intraday drawdown unknown
both chronological stages and validation halves
prior 90-day own-return sign regimes, known before entry
4-week circular moving-block bootstrap 5000 draws seed 24877, descriptive 95% intervals for calendar net and fixed-beta excess

gates.primary_48bps: mean net>0 and PF>1 in training, validation and each validation half
gates.72bps: mean net>0 in training and validation
gates.winner_veto: 48bps mean excluding best event>0 in training, validation and both validation halves
gates.tail_veto: 48bps abs(worst loss)<=0.5*sum positive returns in each of those partitions
gates.concentration: top five positive returns <=0.5*sum positive returns in training and validation
gates.incremental: candidate calendar-week net mean > fixed_beta, reversal, random_timing in both training and validation at 48bps
gates.delay: reject if one_week_delayed equals/exceeds candidate calendar mean in BOTH training and validation
gates.missing_or_underpower: INCONCLUSIVE unless an economic falsifier independently fails; never a survivor
gates.uncertainty: Intervals descriptive only; no confirmatory significance/alpha grant from one retrospective screen
gates.compounded_nav: Net compounded return >0 at48bps in training, validation and both validation halves

multiple_testing.prior_project_tests: All prior tested fingerprints remain in family history; do not pretend this is first search
multiple_testing.alpha_claim: None; full canonical project-family admission mandatory before any formal confirmation or deep/OOS release
multiple_testing.related_active_family: C101_MODERATEVOL_AUTOCORR_V1 / DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1 already studies own-return persistence: preserve shared momentum/autocorrelation ancestry; weekly horizon, unfiltered volatility and long/cash execution differ but do not create an independent statistical family.

authority.negative_result: Preserve exact fingerprint as failed in immutable study evidence; Lead reconciliation to canonical rejected registry separately
authority.positive_result: Only a canonically admitted historical cheap-screen survivor; stop broad searching and seek single deep-candidate transition, fresh OOS design and actual cost qualification; do not call profitable
authority.canonical_admission_blocker: No registered production behavior schema, value/target contract or data-field projection for this weekly spot rule. Requires reviewed canonical support and independent execution-scope admission before acquisition/evaluation. Do not use TEST or existing incompatible schemas.

next_on_failure: No rule tuning; return to the existing ETH #790 admission path or a separately source-frozen materially different mechanism; do not reinterpret controls as discovered candidates.
